low — src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:2651-2654 — a repeated precheck-minimax overwrites the review log and the raw text at a fixed path reviews/<job-id>-v<version>-minimax(.txt|.json) without a newOnly guard; the first live bad-one-sun MiniMax call ran before the parser fix and its log was replaced by the second call; the ledger keeps both calls, so the trail survives, but the first raw output is lost — keep one raw file per callId, or add a refusal when a log already exists for the same job, version, and provider, and record the decision in the plan.

low — src/storytime/book-pictures.ts:2443 — render without --version reuses the newest existing version (options.version ?? existingVersions.at(-1) ?? 1) and then reports status 'skipped'; when v1 exists, a rerun targets v1 and skips, so advancing a picture needs an explicit --version N+1; this matches T7 wording ('A retry writes v2 or refuses') but is a user-flow friction point — add a usage note in the Phase 3 task notes, or print a hint naming the next free version when a render skips.
